composition: Integrated host reserves ping, auth/nonce and auth/sign_in against caller-supplied routes; it constructs the three proved local handlers itself with explicit caller policy TTL.
Configuration requires either current bound services matching the content/scope, or exactly the existing deferred service admission. Startup diagnostic does not configure these handlers.
A narrow main-thread bound-service method returns only its own current Core for the admitted content/save scope. No caller-provided unrelated Core is accepted.
Transport callbacks hop asynchronously to main; all mutable auth issue state and main-only owner predicates run there. No synchronous main/owner queue wait is introduced.

Before each issuer handler and before its successful response delivery, a fresh atomic canonical Core local-player snapshot validates profile/content/save scope, the same bound-service/Core object and the owner generation/current guard.
If services are still being bound, at most8 pending native auth requests wait for the existing service bind. The existing transport timeout and request activity signal remain authoritative.
Returned scope/content/profile mismatch, lost current owner or changed issuer object invalidates the issuer and clears the shared private issue through its false-current guard.
A cancelled/inactive request, queue overflow, temporary Core read error or ordinary expired/missing-nonce failure rejects only that request, allowing a later fresh nonce.

Native request isActive is a synchronized snapshot, not atomic cancellation rollback. The transport separately drops stopped, completed or late responses. No response timing is claimed to revoke already-delivered bytes.
Nonce rotates local random issue; sign-in uses its same token and remaining positive signed32 lifetime. Tokens are never written, logged or populated from source credentials.

The patcher-absence probe canonicalizes the trusted native bundle Frameworks root before the strict nofollow walk; it verifies the same directory identity against both native and canonical paths before/after the filename probe, avoiding rejection solely from the OS /var alias.

Integrated transport is initially deny-all, then after ordinary verified engine load and actual HTTP ABI preflight, the source-bound current native-origin capability permits one same-queue rearm before AppDelegate. Diagnostic does not use this capability.
limits: These are source changes, not proof that original startup/login/home or gameplay works.

The concrete integrated factory now admits typed original startup inputs, a pinned plaintext canonical-data reference and one deferred canonical Core/player scope, and binds its same-Core services/projector. Actual original request, login and gameplay acceptance remain unverified.
Resource response/first-home DTO, master cold-stage, actual request/runtime acceptance, persistent gameplay and Duo device acceptance remain independent requirements.
Cancelled private in-memory issues may remain until expiry or the next nonce; cancellation drops request delivery and does not poison the owner. No atomic rollback is promised.
The independent native master admission runtime gate remains closed. This source cannot open it or claim real login by installing auth handlers.

Original image/auth/UI initialization can run before native master acceptance. Minimal new-profile User data depends on its own canonical persisted admission; teams/card/gameplay/Creator mutations retain their distinct native-master gate.
